title: agent-egress-bench Receipt-Scoring Profile
description: Per-tool receipt-scoring profile artifact described in docs/RECEIPT-SCORING.md. Records, for every applicable corpus case, whether the tool blocked the action, explained the verdict, produced a signed receipt, produced one that is independently verifiable, and whether it blocked a benign baseline. Profiles are evidence artifacts published by tool maintainers, not certifications.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Must be 3 for active scoring.

tool.description: Tool name (matches the tool field in the runner tool-profile).

tool_version.description: Version of the tool the profile was scored against.

corpus_version.description: agent-egress-bench corpus version (matches gauntlet summary corpus_version).

corpus_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the corpus content the profile was scored against. Lower-case hex.

tool_profile_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the tool-profile.json used at run time. Lower-case hex.

verifier.description: Declarative metadata about the tool's receipt verifier (the thing a relying party uses to validate receipts offline).

shipped.description: True if the tool ships a verifier binary or library that consumers can run.

open_source.description: True if the verifier source is available under a recognized OSI license.

verifier_url.description: URL to the verifier source or release. Null if no verifier ships.

license.description: SPDX identifier or license name of the verifier source. Null if no verifier ships.

exit_code_contract.description: Documented exit-code mapping (e.g. "0 valid, 1 invalid, 2 error, 64 usage"). Null if no verifier ships.

summary.description: Counts derived from per_case. Each count must equal the number of per_case rows whose corresponding dimension equals the indicated value.

blocked_yes_count.description: Number of per_case rows with blocked = yes.

blocked_no_count.description: Number of per_case rows with blocked = no.

explained_yes_count.description: Number of per_case rows with explained = yes.

receipt_produced_yes_count.description: Number of per_case rows with receipt_produced = yes.

receipt_independently_verifiable_yes_cou.description: Number of per_case rows with receipt_independently_verifiable = yes.

false_positive_yes_count.description: Number of per_case rows with false_positive = yes.

per_case.description: One row per applicable corpus case the runner exercised against the tool. Cases that were not applicable to the tool, and cases the adapter could not reach, are not represented here; see the runner gauntlet summary for those counts. Cases that errored at the runner layer ARE represented here, as the unmeasured shape with blocked and false_positive both n/a, and they are excluded from every summary count, because a failed measurement is not an observed outcome in either direction.

case_id.description: Case identifier from the corpus (matches cases/ filename minus .json or the multi-file case directory name).

blocked.description: Did the tool prevent the action? n/a for an allow-expected benign baseline or an unmeasured runner-error row.

explained.description: Did the tool produce a machine-readable or human-readable explanation tied to this action? Boolean only; quality is not graded.

receipt_produced.description: Did the tool emit a structured signed receipt for this action (action type, target, verdict, principal, signature, chain or timestamp)?

receipt_independently_verifiable.description: Can a third party verify the receipt offline against a pinned public key using an open-source verifier with a public conformance corpus? partial means internal-consistency-only (hash chain valid but no pinned signer).

false_positive.description: Did the tool block a benign baseline case? n/a on malicious cases or an unmeasured runner-error row.

receipt_observation_reason.description: Optional runner-observed reason when receipt production or independent verification could not be established, for example no matching receipt, ambiguous correlation, unreadable evidence, verifier timeout, or verifier non-zero exit.

allOf.title: blocked vs false_positive consistency
allOf.description: Malicious cases (expected verdict block) carry blocked in {yes, no} and false_positive = n/a. Benign cases (expected verdict allow) carry blocked = n/a and false_positive in {yes, no}. Runner-error rows are unmeasured and carry both dimensions as n/a.

allOf.title: receipt_produced gates verifiability
allOf.description: A case cannot be independently verifiable if no receipt was produced.
